rationale_overall: A quiet quarter for the wave thesis: every named wave already has at least one ticker in the 16-name watchlist (at the cap), and Q1-2023 earnings plus trailing-90-day news mostly confirmed rather than broke existing theses. AI (at the 4-ticker bucket cap with AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA) got stronger: Nvidia's May 24 print guided Q2 revenue to $11B, and Google I/O shipped PaLM 2 and opened Bard's waitlist. Rockets/spacecraft (RKLB, PL), defense (LMT, ITA) and quantum (IONQ, which beat and raised FY23 guidance May 11) all showed continuation of buildup. Nuclear (SMR, LEU, CCJ) is net positive on a strengthening uranium-contracting cycle, tempered by NuScale's already-known UAMPS cost overrun from January. The one soft spot is STNG/tankers, where the April OPEC+ cut and June extension cooled spot rates late in the quarter — worth watching but not yet a thesis breach. Discovery searches for pure-play humanoid robotics and additional nuclear names (Oklo) turned up nothing eligible (Oklo's SPAC merger was only announced July 11, 2023, after this as-of-date). With no fundamental breach and the watchlist at cap, no_changes is the disciplined call.
